tooltip.riftbound.rift_anchor: Overworld only. Use an Echo to begin a trial; sneak with an empty hand to change tier.
tooltip.riftbound.echo_party: Friends: /riftbound ready to opt in for 5 minutes, then gather within 12 blocks.
tooltip.riftbound.verdant_echo: Use on a Rift Anchor to begin a Verdant trial. Found from surface hostile kills.
tooltip.riftbound.ember_echo: Use on a Rift Anchor to begin an Ember trial. Found in dry biomes and the Nether.
tooltip.riftbound.tidal_echo: Use on a Rift Anchor to begin a Tidal trial. Found from river and ocean hostile kills.
tooltip.riftbound.hollow_echo: Use on a Rift Anchor to begin a Hollow trial. Found from hostile kills below Y=0.
tooltip.riftbound.resonance_shard: Earned by completing trials. Eight shards awaken a Dormant Relic.
tooltip.riftbound.dormant_relic: An unawakened vessel. Surround with eight Resonance Shards to attune a relic.
tooltip.riftbound.wayfarer_relic: Offhand: grants Speed I and Jump Boost I.
advancement.riftbound.root.title: A World That Answers
advancement.riftbound.root.description: Find or craft an Echo of the wild.
advancement.riftbound.anchor.title: Hold the Rift
advancement.riftbound.anchor.description: Craft a Rift Anchor for an Overworld trial.
advancement.riftbound.shard.title: A Resonant Victory
advancement.riftbound.shard.description: Obtain a Resonance Shard from a completed trial.
advancement.riftbound.relic.title: Carry the Wild
advancement.riftbound.relic.description: Attune a relic with eight Resonance Shards.
message.riftbound.convergence.requires_t: [Riftbound] Convergence requires an unlocked Adept or Exalted trial. Sneak-use the anchor with an empty main hand to choose a tier.
message.riftbound.convergence.unavailabl: [Riftbound] Convergence rewards are unavailable. Check that the Convergence bridge is installed; your offerings were not consumed.
message.riftbound.convergence.started: [Riftbound] Convergence active! Avoid the marked hazard zones. Warnings last at least 2 seconds. Complete the trial for bonus resonance and Concordance.
message.riftbound.convergence.reward: [Riftbound] Convergence stabilized: %s Resonance Shards and 1 Concordance!
message.riftbound.hazard.verdant: [Riftbound] Verdant roots are forming! Leave the green marked patch before it slows you.
message.riftbound.hazard.ember: [Riftbound] Ember resonance is surging! Leave the two flame-marked lanes; the pulse deals magic damage.
message.riftbound.hazard.tidal: [Riftbound] A tidal current is gathering! Leave the splash-marked ring or be pulled inward.
message.riftbound.hazard.hollow: [Riftbound] Hollow resonance is gathering! Leave the purple marked lane before it weakens you.
